faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up your workspace, connecting channels, and managing your data.
faq.q1: What file types can I upload?
faq.a1: Redas supports PDFs, Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx), plain text (.txt), Markdown (.md), and live website URLs. Our ingestion engine automatically parses, cleans, and indexes content into your workspace knowledge base.
faq.q2: How many languages does Redas support?
faq.a2: Redas natively understands and responds in all local languages (Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, Tigrinya, Somali) as well as English and international languages. The agent automatically detects the incoming message's language and replies accurately.
faq.q3: Can I connect Telegram and WhatsApp at the same time?
faq.a3: Yes. You can deploy the same trained agent to your Web Widget, WhatsApp Business number, and Telegram bot simultaneously. All channels share one central brain and unified knowledge base.
faq.q4: Is my organization's data isolated from other tenants?
faq.a4: Yes, completely. Redas is built on a multi-tenant architecture with strict tenant-level row isolation and encrypted vector stores. Your documents and chat histories are accessible only to authorized members.
faq.q5: Can I customize the generated PowerPoint/Word templates?
faq.a5: Yes. The DocGen engine allows you to specify custom presentation structures, executive summary formats, spreadsheet schemas, and brand styling so your generated artifacts are client- and board-ready.
